description.en: Build-only, read-only reconciliation of all34 canonical Box contracts against closed compiler bindings and actual checked source compositions.
description.ko: Box 원본34개 계약을 직접 제공자·실제 소스 조합·오류 및 콜백 차이·미제공 항목으로 나눈 build 전용 초안이다.

basis.namespace: Explicit import memory. Box is compiler-injected; there is no ordinary library/Core/memory.avx or standalone generic Box implementation to substitute for the closed binding.
basis.placeholder_warning: Injected public void declarations are compiler placeholders. The closed resolver, type checker and lowering determine actual result and effect behavior; ordinary body text is not the ABI.

interpretation: The30 unsupported canonical names are not30 entirely absent behaviors:11 have actual checked compositions.
Nineteen rows still have no concrete provider in the searched compiler/source surface.
The7 same-carrier compositions still require namespace/API and full cost/error/retained-input/lifetime reconciliation; they are not declared fully complete.
The3 adapted error carriers are Box.copy/from_array/from_vector through Box.new InputError<T>, compared with canonical CollectionError/OwnerError<T>.
Box.compare has a checked hash.Ord/i32-to-Ordering route, but its explicit arbitrary Compare<T> callback contract is not supplied by that route.
All34 remain0.3 CPU catalog targets. Nothing is silently deferred to0.4; no GPU behavior is introduced.

compile_only_verification.scope: Only --check was run. No invalid source was AOT/JIT-executed; no Box fault injection, Drop-count runtime proof, sanitizer run or cross-target execution is claimed. The parent-owned138-test suite is separate.
compile_only_verification.generic_boundary: Generic helper declarations were checked through the concrete recorded instantiations. This is not an independent proof over every generic type/interface implementation or exact conceptual callback alias.

records.name: Box.allocation_bytes
records.contract: Payload allocation request size; excludes allocator bookkeeping.
remaining_contract_notes: No public Box allocation-request introspection callable or source-level target-layout primitive was found. The backend knows layout internally but that is not a user-callable API.
Box.new currently requests max(1,layout size); this internal implementation fact does not provide allocation_bytes(owner) or allocator-bookkeeping reporting.
